annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: NIST's voluntary, sector-agnostic AI Risk Management Framework (January 2023) helps organizations manage AI risks and promote trustworthy AI. It defines seven trustworthiness characteristics and a Core of four functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage), plus profiles. It has no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector-specific, use-case-agnostic framework mandated by the National AI Initiative Act of 2020
Seven trustworthiness characteristics: valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable, privacy-enhanced, fair
AI RMF Core with four functions: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage, with categories and subcategories
Risk management should span the whole AI lifecycle and involve diverse, multidisciplinary AI actors
Living document with a Playbook, profiles, and formal review by 2028
